events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and solo artist Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Iconic frontman
angles.copy: Happy 54th to the one and only Liam Gallagher! What's your favourite lyric or moment from the man himself?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album released 55 years ago
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic second solo studio album, 'Imagine', was released on October 8, 1971, in the UK and September 9, 1971, in the US.

angles.name: Imagine's message
angles.copy: 55 years since John Lennon released 'Imagine'. Its message of peace and unity still resonates today. What does this song mean to you?

events.title: Sting turns 75
events.blurb: Gordon Matthew Thomas Sumner, known as Sting, the legendary musician from The Police and a successful solo artist, celebrates his 75th birthday.

angles.name: Sting's musical journey
angles.copy: From The Police to a stellar solo career, Sting turns 75 today! Which of his hits gets you every time?

events.title: 25 years since the first iPod was released
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first-generation iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising how people listened to music.

angles.name: iPod nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? It's 25 years since the original iPod dropped, changing music forever. What was your first iPod and what was on it?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated annually as James Bond Day, marking the release date of the very first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Best Bond theme
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! Time to debate: which iconic Bond theme song is the absolute best?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today marks what would have been the 86th birthday of the legendary Beatles co-founder, John Lennon, born in Liverpool in 1940.

angles.name: Lennon's legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese, best known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Cleese's comedic genius
angles.copy: Happy 87th to the legendary John Cleese! What's your favourite Monty Python sketch or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released 58 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but commonly known as the 'White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album deep dive
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles gave us the 'White Album'. A sprawling masterpiece – what's your standout track from this double LP?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's passing
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the death of Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away in 1991.

angles.name: Tribute to Freddie
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury today. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released 61 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles released their sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', on December 3, 1965, marking a significant shift in their musical direction.

angles.name: Rubber Soul's influence
angles.copy: 61 years since The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' arrived. This album changed everything! What's your favourite track from this groundbreaking record?

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of John Lennon in New York City on December 8, 1980.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On this day, we remember John Lennon. His music and message for peace continue to resonate globally.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: David Bowie, the influential British singer, songwriter, and actor, would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Bowie's enduring artistry
angles.copy: Remembering the Starman on what would have been his 80th birthday. David Bowie's artistry continues to inspire. What's your favourite Bowie era?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, born in Mississippi in 1935, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Long live the King
angles.copy: On what would have been his 92nd birthday, we celebrate the enduring legacy of Elvis Presley. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist and songwriter Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar god
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the one and only Jimmy Page! His riffs shaped rock 'n' roll forever. What's your favourite Pagey guitar moment?
